claim: Cisco's diluted EPS was $3.07 USD in fiscal Q4 2023.
summary: The $3.07 figure matches Cisco's reported full-year FY2023 GAAP diluted EPS, not fiscal Q4 2023. Parametric knowledge indicates Q4 FY2023 GAAP diluted EPS was ~$0.96 (non-GAAP ~$1.14), so attributing $3.07 to Q4 2023 conflates annual with quarterly results.
